purpose: U12: smoke test of llm-serve (a Service replica image) on at least 3 GPU models
gpu_models_note: Minimum is 3 distinct models; the fleet is the owner's decision. A serving image never exits, so this spec uses a `service` step (kits/README.md, Smoke test spec): kits/tools/smoke_runner.py starts the image like service_agent.DockerServiceContainer, polls /health, POSTs one chat completion, stops.

fixture.how: none: the check posts a fixed prompt at temperature 0 and compares token counts and the answer shape, not text

checks.expect: GET /health on port 8000 returns 2xx within the start limit, with the container on an --internal network and no published port
POST /v1/chat/completions with model 'model', max_tokens 16, temperature 0 returns 200 and a non-empty choices[0].message.content
run with --network none or --internal succeeds and the process makes no outbound connection (HF_HUB_OFFLINE)
starts with --read-only --tmpfs /tmp --user 65532:65532 --cap-drop ALL (the service agent's flags)
a flipped byte in a baked weight file makes the container exit 2 with asset_hash_mismatch before serving
